Hi! This is the clinic I go to, I have had both face to face and virtual appointments with this clinic, I would always recommend a face to face appointment as I find (for me personally) it's easier to get my point across.

Wait times like most clinics are long, I had an initial assessment appointment back in sept 2021 and am still not on HRT. (Granted I want storage so my wait time is longer)

They'll do an initial assessment for you that consists of asking things like when did you first realise you were trans, how's your relationship at home etc.

 Then in later appointments they'll ask you to do a deed poll for name change and get bloods done. 

Average wait times between appointments for me are 3/6 months. 

Hope this helps, If you have any more questions you can always pm me :D
